title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Service Response Standards
content:
For each rider of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons Bridgewell publishes how quickly the contractor contacts the customer on a rider service request, whether rider failures can be handled as emergencies, and whether a rider item serviced in the same visit and trade as a base contract request carries no separate fee.

| Rider | Routine contact (hours) | Emergency service available | Emergency contact (hours) | No separate fee when serviced in the same visit and trade as a base contract request |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider | 48 | No | 0 (not available) | Yes |
| Bridgewell Septic System Rider | 48 | Yes | 24 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Well Pump Rider | 48 | Yes | 24 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider | 72 | Yes | 24 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider | 48 | No | 0 (not available) | Yes |
| Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider | 48 | No | 0 (not available) | Yes |
| Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider | 48 | Yes | 24 | Yes |

## What the columns mean

- **Routine contact**: the hours within which the contractor contacts the customer on a routine rider request.
- **Emergency service available**: whether rider failures can be handled as emergencies.
- **Emergency contact**: the hours within which the contractor contacts the customer on an emergency rider request; 0 where emergency service is not available.
- **No separate fee in a shared visit**: whether a rider item serviced in the same visit and trade as a base contract request carries no separate fee.

## Points of reference

**Which riders offer emergency handling?** The Bridgewell Septic System Rider, the Bridgewell Well Pump Rider, the Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider and the Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider, each with contact within 24 hours.

**Which rider has the longest routine contact window?** The Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider, at 72 hours; every other rider shows 48 hours.
